title: Eisenstein integers and the ramification 3 ~ (1-ω)^2
notes: Standard dictionary 3 is associate to (1-ω)^2 in Z[ω]. Translating the cubic N2 law p ≡ q (mod 3^r) into p ≡ q (mod (1-ω)^{2r}) is a change of uniformizer, not a new fibre theorem. No source found that states the residual Newton-stratum laws on Int(Z[ω]).
